name: transitland-mcp-server
description: Global transit data via the Transitland v2 registry — operators, GTFS/GTFS-RT/GBFS feeds with license terms, routes, stops, and real-time-aware departures via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

TRANSITLAND_API_KEY.title: Transitland API Key
TRANSITLAND_API_KEY.description: Required. Transitland v2 API key, sent as the apikey query parameter. Get one at the Transitland developer portal (transit.land).
